parts:
Hello,

Using the code and data (reproducible example) shown below, I have drawn two maps - qplot and ggplot. 
Acknowledgement: Hadley Wicham for the qplot example in ggplot2 (pages 78-79).

The issues are as follows:

1) Alaska and Hawaii are not displayed in the map. I am not sure whether the longitude and latitude data for these two States are extracted.
2) There appear to be some problems in the map created by the ggplot () - some tweaking of the code is needed.
3) I could not figure out how to add the State code to the map in qplot as well as ggplot.

I would appreciate receiving any advice/help toward resolving the issues.

Happy New Year!

Thanks and regards,

Pradip Muhuri
